To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

microgravity environments can be used as a unique lens for understanding human social relations, emotion and cognition, by highlighting the importance of the ethno physical context of the body in the formation of social relations.
the experience of microgravity environments is a unique vantage from which to consider the relationship between the body, emotion, and cognition.

the experience of microgravity has the potential to disrupt the affective landscape of human interaction and that this disruption is a useful lens through which we can understand the social relations of gravity.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how the absence of gravity affects the social relations of astronauts and their interactions with others on Earth.
how the human body and social relations are shaped by the gravity that is absent in space and how these experiences can be used to understand the human relationship to gravity on earth.

the ways in which the body, emotion, cognition, social relations and environments interact and co-constitute each other, in order to understand how the absence of gravity can be understood as a unique vantage for social science.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
gravity is a social force that is not only physical, but is also a social and emotional force, that is felt, and that can be experienced as such.
an anthropology of gravity is necessary for the study of human space travel and its implications for social relations and human interaction.

an anthropology of gravity is a useful way to think about the relationship between human beings and the world in which they live, and the way that this is affected and changed when that world is altered in some way.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are trying to understand how the absence of gravity changes the human body, the way we feel and the way we interact.
the absence of gravity, and its effects on the body, offers an opportunity to re-examine our relationship with gravity and its effects on our emotions and social relations.

the absence of gravity, or the presence of microgravity, has an affect on human social relations, cognition, emotion and the body in a way that can be used as an ethnographic lens through which to understand the human relationship to the material world.
The main takeaway from our work is that
microgravity environments can be used to understand the relationship between the body, emotion, cognition and social relations.
the absence of gravity is a unique and powerful tool to understand human social interaction.
gravity is a fundamental force that structures human interaction.
